thesis: There is no best AI video generator — the five tools are specialists competing for five different creators, so the only comparison that matters is which one fits the job you need done.
frame: This is a hiring decision, not a talent show: you are interviewing five specialist candidates against one job description — yours — so every demo is an interview task, the pricing section is the salary negotiation, and the summary table is the hiring scorecard.

throughline.name: the-candidate-roster
throughline.description: A five-slot candidate roster: one card per tool (OpenArt, Higgsfield, Synthesia, HeyGen, Arcads), styled like a hiring shortlist.
throughline.evolution: Opens as five blank, equal candidate cards in the intro roll call; after each tool's demo its card earns a specialty stamp (creative hub / cinematic director / corporate presenter / solo studio / ad factory); the pricing section pins a salary tag on every card; the summary table fills each card's scorecard row by row; in the conclusion no card is crowned — instead each card is handed to the persona it was hired for, ending as five filled offers to five different people.
